# @fyit/crouton-core

> Base CRUD framework with collections, forms, tables, and team support

## Components

- `CroutonBlockFrame`: Shared chrome for editor-block node views: selected border, label row, edit and delete buttons
- `CroutonBoolean`: Check or cross icon for a boolean value
- `CroutonCalendar`: Date or date-range picker calendar
- `CroutonCollection`: Full CRUD table with multi-layout support
- `CroutonCollectionViewer`: Collection list with a header and layout switcher
- `CroutonConfirmButton`: Two-click inline confirmation button
- `CroutonDate`: Formatted date display
- `CroutonDefaultCard`: Display-aware card
- `CroutonDeleteButton`: Themed delete button
- `CroutonDependentFieldCardMini`: Shows dependent field values, resolving ID references from the parent item
- `CroutonDetail`: Generic detail view using display config
- `CroutonFormActionButton`: Submit button for a collection form action (create, update, delete)
- `CroutonFormColorPicker`: Color picker with preset swatches and a custom picker
- `CroutonFormDependentFieldLoader`: Loads the custom or default input for a dependent form field
- `CroutonFormDependentSelectOption`: Select input for options that depend on another field
- `CroutonFormLayout`: Form layout with slots
- `CroutonFormOptionsSelect`: Select menu for options from a settings collection
- `CroutonFormReferenceSelect`: Single or multiple select for references to another collection
- `CroutonFormRepeater`: Repeatable list of form items with drag-to-reorder
- `CroutonIconPicker`: Searchable icon picker using the Iconify public API
- `CroutonImageCropper`: Image crop area with a rotate toolbar
- `CroutonImageUpload`: File picker with optional crop support
- `CroutonImportButton`: Button to import CSV or JSON into a collection
- `CroutonItemButtonsMini`: Compact view, edit and delete buttons for an item
- `CroutonItemCardMini`: Compact card that fetches and shows a referenced item
- `CroutonOptionsFieldCardMini`: Shows options field values resolved from a settings collection
- `CroutonQrCode`: Renders any string (typically a URL) as a scannable QR code
- `CroutonRedirectsList`: List of team URL redirects
- `CroutonSubBar`: Thin secondary bar under a primary toolbar or header
- `CroutonTableHeader`: Header bar for a collection table
- `CroutonTabsPanel`: Shared shell for a tabbed admin section: one top bar with title and tabs
- `CroutonTreeView`: Hierarchical drag-and-drop tree of collection items
- `CroutonUsersCardMini`: Compact user avatar with optional name
- `CroutonValidationErrorSummary`: Summary of form validation errors per tab
- `CroutonWorkspaceEditor`: Inline item editor for the workspace layout
- `CroutonWorkspaceLayout`: Reusable split-panel workspace shell

Props, events and slots: [components.md](components.md)

## Composables

- `useCollectionImport`
- `useCollections`
- `useCroutonApps`
- `useDisplayConfig`
